_about: Design tokens for the app forge builds. forge-design design fills them in as roles (what each colour does); forge-design brand later swaps the values for your own palette. Names stay, values change. Sizes are in px. Check every change with: python3 ../forge-design/contrast.py forge-work/design/tokens.json
_pairs: Every text and background combination the app uses. Third item: large (text from 24px, or 18.66px bold) needs 3:1; ui (input borders, icons, focus rings) needs 3:1; left out means normal text, which needs 4.5:1. Every text colour (text, fg or on in its name) must be in a pair; disabled ones, dividers and card borders need none. Dark theme: add a dark group inside color and pairs such as ["dark-text", "dark-bg"].
_notes: The accent (a neutral grey placeholder here) comes from the picked concept; forge-design brand may change it later. Clone mode: list here every value you estimated instead of reading it off a screenshot's pixels or an eyedropper, such as: estimated: surface, border, radius.
_size: Fixed sizes that are not spacing, in px: border and focus ring widths, icons, control heights, the 44px target for main actions on mobile, a dialog's width. Add what the components need, by role.
_tints: tint, tint-strong and scrim mix other tokens (hovers and wells; pressed rows and skeletons; a dialog backdrop): written once, they follow the theme by themselves, light or dark, and need no pair. That holds in CSS: theme.py's scss and js write them with the light values, so a Sass or JS theme that uses one in dark gives the dark group its own. More such colours are fine, with no text, fg or on in their names.
_type: A type step takes size and line (px) and weight; with a variable font also stretch, its width (125 is 125%, or condensed), and tracking (-0.02 is -0.02em), when the concept uses them.
_chart: Chart roles, for dashboards (forge-design dashboard Step 6): the series colours chart-1 to chart-4 (up to chart-6), each with 3:1 on bg and surface (ui pairs); chart-1 is the accent, written as var(--color-accent), so it follows a rebrand and the dark theme and the accent's pairs check it. chart-grid, the faint grid lines (no pair); the sequential ramp chart-seq-1 (low) to chart-seq-5 for a value matrix or heat map, with the text on its first and last step (4.5:1). Fit them to the concept, the ramp in the accent's hue, each with its dark value and dark pairs.
_motion: forge-design design Step 2 adds the motion keys of ../forge-design/motion.md section 2 here (slow, slower, stagger, pulse, loop, ease-exit, ease-move, ease-spring) and shift-sm, shift, shift-lg to size: motion.css reads them, with radius.sm and size.ring, and a missing one makes its rule do nothing.

font.sans: Inter Variable, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif
